_comment: Levels, labels and customs [VERIFY] with a teacher of the country before the preset is advertised (PLAN.md 9.41). 고등학교 (general, special-purpose 특목고 and autonomous 자사고, three years): classes written 1학년 2반, as in kr-jung, and re-formed every year, so the promotion clears them [VERIFY]. The vocational (특성화고) schools may use other names for the years [VERIFY]. Pupils come from the 3학년 of kr-jung after the school assignment (고교 배정) or an entrance examination, so there is no link between the two presets. The school year (학년도) starts on 1 March and is named by its starting year, as in kr-jung [VERIFY]. After the 3학년 a pupil leaves.
